app.title: Better Vector Search for Long Documents: Chunking Inside Manticore Search
app.author: GloriaVinogrado
app.description: Manticore Search with automatic chunking for efficient long-document vector similarity search
proposed_tests: Clone repo and build from source
Index a set of 1000 documents with chunking enabled
Execute a similarity query and verify result relevance
Measure query latency and compare to baseline without chunking
